title.en: Free and subsidised AI help for Victorian small businesses
title.zh: 维州小生意能用上的免费和资助的 AI 帮助

notes.en: No government AI program delivered in Chinese was found (checked 22 October 2026). City of Melbourne's Business Concierge offers interpreters.
notes.zh: 截至 2026-10-22，没找到用中文上课的政府 AI 项目。墨尔本市的 Business Concierge 提供口译。

name.en: Digital Solutions (Australian Small Business Advisory Services)
name.zh: Digital Solutions（联邦小企业咨询服务）

records.provider: Melbourne Innovation Centre (delivers the Australian Government program in Victoria, SA and Tasmania)

cost.en: A$110 for the whole package (up to 5 hours of one-on-one mentoring); registration, webinars, workshops and online courses are free
cost.zh: 整套 A$110（最多 5 小时一对一辅导）；注册、讲座、工作坊、网课免费

eligibility.en: For-profit, has an ABN, fewer than 20 full-time equivalent staff (sole traders included), in Victoria, South Australia or Tasmania. One package per business.
eligibility.zh: 营利、有 ABN、少于 20 个全职等效员工（含个体户），在维州、南澳或塔州。一家只能买一套。

summary.en: 12-week program in intakes (waitlist when full). Mentoring by video; workshops in person in Melbourne. Applications open; funded until 2031 per MIC.
summary.zh: 12 周，分批开班，满了排队。辅导用视频，工作坊在墨尔本现场。正在接受申请；MIC 写政府资助到 2031 年。

sources.quote: Your cost is $110 for the whole package
A small fee will be charged

name.zh: Business Victoria 免费线上咨询

eligibility.en: One 45-minute session per business every 12 months.
eligibility.zh: 每家每 12 个月一次，45 分钟。

summary.en: Free 45-minute online session with an adviser; some advisers list AI integration as a topic.
summary.zh: 免费 45 分钟线上咨询，有顾问列了「AI integration」。

name.zh: Digital Jobs Program（数字岗位计划）

eligibility.en: Fewer than 200 employees; only certain industries (the page lists construction among them). Round 3 open until the end of 2026.
eligibility.zh: 少于 200 名员工；只限部分行业（页面列了 construction）。第 3 轮开放到 2026 年底。

summary.en: Includes AI training for staff of eligible businesses.
summary.zh: 包含给合格企业员工的 AI 培训。

name.en: National AI Centre free templates and micro-courses
name.zh: 国家 AI 中心的免费模板和微课

summary.en: Free AI policy template, AI register template, screening questions and short courses. NAIC also runs free AI courses with TAFE NSW. business.gov.au helpline: 13 28 46.
summary.zh: 免费的 AI 政策模板、AI 登记表模板、风险筛查问题和短课；国家 AI 中心还和 TAFE NSW 合办免费 AI 课。business.gov.au 热线 13 28 46。

name.zh: AI Adopt Centres（AI 采用中心）

eligibility.en: Only businesses in National Reconstruction Fund priority areas (e.g. medical science, agriculture).
eligibility.zh: 只限国家重建基金（NRF）优先行业，如医学科学、农业。

summary.en: Free specialist AI adoption help for businesses in NRF priority areas; not for most cafés, shops or trades.
summary.zh: 给 NRF 优先行业的免费 AI 专业服务；大多数餐馆、小店、手艺人不在范围内。

cost.en: Free hotline and 45-minute consultation; AI Audit A$1,000
cost.zh: 热线和 45 分钟咨询免费；AI Audit A$1,000

eligibility.en: Generally businesses with fewer than 200 employees.
eligibility.zh: 一般是少于 200 名员工的企业。

summary.en: Free hotline 1800 517 403 and a free 45-minute consultation.
summary.zh: 免费热线 1800 517 403，免费 45 分钟咨询。

name.zh: SEED-AI 免费 AI 培训（迪肯大学）

records.provider: Deakin University (listed by City of Monash)

eligibility.en: Businesses, educators and employees; 300 places per intake.
eligibility.zh: 企业、教育者和员工；每期 300 人。

summary.en: Online, 10 hours of live classes. Next intake 9 November 2026.
summary.zh: 线上，10 小时直播课。下一期 2026-11-09。

name.en: Victoria University short course: AI for Small Business
name.zh: 维多利亚大学短课：AI for Small Business

summary.en: 8 weeks, self-paced, online. Intakes October 2026 and mid-January 2027.
summary.zh: 8 周，自学，线上。2026 年 10 月一期，2027 年 1 月中一期。

name.en: NAB AI masterclasses (with the National AI Centre)
name.zh: NAB 和国家 AI 中心合办的 AI 大师课

summary.en: Recordings can be watched any time.

summary.zh: 免费 AI 学习模块。

eligibility.en: Businesses in the City of Melbourne
eligibility.zh: 墨尔本市辖区内的企业

summary.en: Business support service that offers interpreters.
summary.zh: 企业支持服务，提供口译。
